8.3.3.3 Dem_GetComponentFailed
[SWS_Dem_01115] Definition of API function Dem_GetComponentFailed ⌈
Service Name
Dem_GetComponentFailed
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_GetComponentFailed (
Dem_ComponentIdType ComponentId,
boolean* ComponentFailed
)
Service ID [hex]
0x2a
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
ComponentId
Identification of a DemComponent
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
ComponentFailed
TRUE: failed FALSE: not failed
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: getting "ComponentFailed" was successful
E_NOT_OK: getting "ComponentFailed" was not successful
Description
Gets the failed status of a DemComponent.
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
